text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Early summer gives way to the hum of 
cicadas, and the morning breeze turns 
warm. 
――Amidst that atmosphere, our Summer 
Training Camp begins.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aha~ It's finally starting! 
The delightful, fun-filled Summer Training 
Camp!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm? You're plotting something, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, cease your unfounded suspicions. 
As a mere student, I merely wish to enjoy 
the camp to the fullest and foster my 
mental and physical growth.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Liar! Just the other day you were 
grumbling about how "training at the 
academy would be far more efficient"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Your ears must be playing tricks on you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is research regarding the "mental and 
physical changes in Umamusume during 
extended group lodging activities"...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Exten... huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"At this academy, the Summer Training Camp 
is an event expected to provide special 
training as well as the educational 
benefits typical of extended group lodging 
activities."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"To determine the extent to which 
Umamusume exhibit psychological growth, 
and the physiological effects resulting 
from it, meticulous data will be collected 
this summer――"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! Stop, stop it, what do you think 
you're doing?! Are you trying to ruin 
everything?! 
And in the first place, where on earth did 
you get those confidential documents――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From the floor of our shared space... 
...I see, so they were confidential 
documents after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aha, see! You *were* plotting something 
weird!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! Whether it is "weird" or not 
is entirely subjective, but all I am doing 
is taking the Summer Training Camp 
seriously and having fun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have no plans for any glowing or changes 
in coat color that would make you scowl! 
You see, my conduct will be exemplary... I 
will merely be collecting a tiny bit of 
data.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, this is a training camp, yet 
they treat it like a field trip... 
I only hope they don't cause too much of a 
ruckus at the lodge.
Event Title.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone has arrived. From here 
on, we'll be living as a group. Let's make 
a conscious effort to cooperate with one 
another even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Those of you with Trainers, please follow 
your Trainer's instructions. 
And with that, you are dismissed for now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am the leader of Room 207――Air Groove. 
I look forward to working with you. Come, 
let's head to our room first.

text_block_list.name: Room 207 Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Yes." 
"Present!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……Hey, are you two listening, Tachyon, 
Pokke!? 
You guys are in Room 207 too."

text_block_list.name: Tachyon & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? Yeah, yeah, I'm listening." 
"Huh? Yeah, I hear ya."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oho, so this is the space we shall share 
starting today. 
Well, not bad at all. First, let's 
investigate every single corner……"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The view is…… not bad. 
The closet is packed with futons—wait, 
where is it? Where's the snack tray?!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Dummy, this ain't an inn! 
……Whoa, there's a fridge! Let's put cola 
in it! Cola!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, everyone pile your luggage in 
the corner of the room. 
Even if it's the first day, we're going to 
be busy, so change into your tracksuits 
quickly."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(And so, summer training camp kicked off, 
but——)

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaa! It's so wide! So blue! Running 
here is so much fun!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Instructor, Instructor~! 
If I train here, I feel like my times are 
gonna drop like crazy~!"

text_block_list.name: Gluttonous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Aah~, the BBQ party on the final day last 
year was so fun~! 
Piles of carrots, fruit, all-you-can-eat 
to our hearts' content!"

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, I won a handheld fan in the 
bingo game after the BBQ, 
and it's so good, like, I'm gonna use it 
forever."

text_block_list.name: Neat and Proper Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Phew……! I guess being in an unfamiliar 
place really made me 
tense up……. Fufu, it's washing away all 
the fatigue of the day."

text_block_list.name: Sunny Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm looking forward to dinner too…… 
Oh, wait, 
wasn't I on meal prep duty?! Sorry, I 
gotta get out now."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ——Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"——Huuuh?! Tachyon is the BBQ committee 
chair?! 
You…… you went that far?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hahahaha! Naturally! 
Nobody will enjoy this summer camp more 
than this year's Agnes Tachyon!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, the BBQ is a major event for 
the entire student body. The more 
stimulating the day, 
the stronger the stimulus to everyone's 
reward system. Therefore, I must set the 
stage!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"We came to training camp…… to train……. 
You should show some motivation…… for that 
too……"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"How extraordinarily 'sensible' of you to 
say. 
……Well, you do have a point. I am one of 
the guinea pigs this time, after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"——Regardless, for a while, we share the 
same roof and eat from the same pot. 
Let us relish this extraordinary situation 
to the fullest!"
